features.name: Buy Bonus
features.description: Players can buy direct entry into one of the three different bonus features, ranging from 95x to 777x the base bet.

features.name: Free Spins
features.description: Triggered by 3 or 4 scatter symbols, awarding 7 or 10 free spins respectively. xWays symbols remain sticky for the feature's duration.

features.name: Expanding Reels
features.description: xWays symbols reveal 2-4 identical symbols, expanding the number of ways to win. All xWays symbols reveal the same symbol type.

features.name: Symbol Transformation
features.description: xSplit Wilds split all symbols to the left on the same row, transforming them into multiple symbols.

features.name: Symbol Removal
features.description: Collecting xWays symbols allows players to level up from level 1 to level 3, with each level removing low paying symbols as an upgrade.

specs.description: xWays Hoarder xSplit combines the innovative xWays mechanic with xSplit Wilds in a hoarding-themed slot. Players collect xWays symbols that remain sticky during Bunker Raid Spins, while xSplit Wilds split symbols to create more winning opportunities and level progression removes low-paying symbols.

functional_symbols.name: xSplit Wild
functional_symbols.description: Splits all symbols to the left on the same row, creating multiple symbols from single positions

functional_symbols.name: xWays Symbol
functional_symbols.description: Reveals 2-4 identical symbols, all xWays symbols show the same symbol type

functional_symbols.name: Scatter
functional_symbols.description: Triggers Bunker Raid Spins, can be upgraded to Super Scatter which converts symbols below to xWays

features.name: Collect Feature
features.context: H3 sections describing Azteca Collect Symbol types
features.description: Azteca Collect symbols on reel 5 gather values from Azteca Gold symbols on reels 1-4 in a single action. Five types: basic Collect, Plus Collect (adds value to each gold), Multiplier Collect (multiplies each gold), Expand Collect (fills reels with golds), and Respin Collect (holds golds for respin).

features.name: Cash On Reels
features.context: Game Rules section describing Azteca Gold symbols
features.description: Azteca Gold symbols appear on reels 1-4 and contain random win values that are collected by Azteca Collect symbols on reel 5.

features.name: Free Spins
features.context: H2 section Free Spins Bonus Feature
features.description: 3 or more Bonus symbols award 16 free spins. During free spins, Azteca Gold values accumulate in a pot and return as a giant symbol covering reels 1-4 for a final respin with potential collection.

features.name: Respin
features.description: Respin Collect symbol holds Azteca Gold symbols in place and triggers a respin, then awards the total value of all gold symbols.

specs.description: Azteca Gold Collect is a 5x3 reel slot with 25 paylines featuring an innovative collect mechanic where Azteca Gold symbols on reels 1-4 hold random values that are gathered by various Azteca Collect symbols on reel 5. The game includes free spins with an accumulating pot feature and multiple collection variants including expand and respin options.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Bonus, Azteca Gold and Azteca Collect

functional_symbols.name: Azteca Gold
functional_symbols.description: Contains random win values, appears on reels 1-4, collected by Azteca Collect symbols

functional_symbols.name: Azteca Collect
functional_symbols.description: Appears on reel 5, collects and awards values from Azteca Gold symbols with various modifiers

functional_symbols.name: Bonus

features.name: Free Spins

features.name: Hold and Spin
features.description: Triggered with 4+ Hold & Respin scatter symbols, locks triggering symbols and respins remaining positions with 3 lives that reset when new scatters land.

features.name: Static Jackpot
features.description: Three fixed jackpots awarded by landing 4-6 jackpot symbols: Silver (50x), Gold (500x), and Crypto (5,000x).

features.name: Megaways
features.description: Licensed Big Time Gaming Megaways mechanic with variable ways to win per spin.

features.name: Symbol Upgrade
features.description: Randomly triggered feature where an oversized 2x1 upgrade symbol on the bonus reel upgrades a random symbol to a higher value.

features.name: Cascading Reels
features.context: Free Spins section mentioning '+1 for every cascade'
features.description: Winning symbols are removed and new symbols fall to create additional winning opportunities, with cascades affecting the multiplier counter in free spins.

features.name: Multiplier
features.description: A global multiplier that starts at 1x and increases by +1 for every cascade during the free spins bonus.

specs.description: Money Megaways is a Megaways slot featuring symbol upgrades, cascading reels, and multiple bonus rounds. The game offers free spins with progressive multipliers, a hold & respin bonus with monetary values, and three fixed jackpots up to 5,000x bet.

features.name: Free Spins

features.name: Expanding Reels
features.context: Slot Overview and Punk Rocker Features sections
features.description: The xWays Mystery Symbol holds 2-4 symbols and expands reels up to 6 symbols high. Punk characters may be super-expanded up to 20 symbols high. Game starts with 243 ways but can expand to 46,656 ways during bonus features.
characteristics: up to 20 symbols high for punk characters

features.name: Respin
features.description: Main game feature triggered by two scatters, providing an explosive respin with locked Molotov Wilds and an unlocked 6th reel for at least 729 win ways.

features.name: Expanding Wilds
features.description: Molotov Wilds substitute for any symbol except scatter and expand upwards on the reels for huge hits.

specs.description: Punk Rocker xWays is a high-volatility music-themed slot featuring the xWays expanding reel mechanic that can grow from 243 ways to 46,656 ways to win. The game includes Riot Respins, dual freespin modes with jumping wilds, and Molotov expanding wilds for explosive gameplay.

functional_symbols.name: xWays Mystery Symbol
functional_symbols.description: Holds 2-4 symbols and expands reels up to 6 symbols high, with punk characters potentially expanding up to 20 symbols high

functional_symbols.name: Molotov Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except scatter and expands upwards on reels

functional_symbols.name: Scatter
functional_symbols.description: Triggers various features: 2 scatters trigger Riot Respin, 3 scatters trigger Anarchy Freespins, 4 scatters trigger Civil War Freespins

functional_symbols.name: Jumping Wild
functional_symbols.description: Scatters transform into these during freespin features, providing wild substitution throughout the bonus rounds

features.name: Free Spins
features.description: Triggered by Free Spin symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5. Player chooses from 3 options: 10 spins with 2 wild reels, 5 spins with 3 wild reels, or 2 spins with 4 wild reels. Wild reels change positions after each spin.

features.name: Wild Reels
features.description: Activates after every tenth spin in base game. Reels with lit indicators become entirely wild for one spin. Progress is saved per bet level.

features.name: Wheel
features.description: Triggered when wild progress bar reaches certain counts (25, 50, 75, 100, 200). Bonus wheel awards 2-5 spins. Super Bonus at 200 count spins wheel 3 times.

features.name: Persistence
features.context: H3 section WILD REELS FEATURE and BONUS GAME
features.description: Progress indicators and bonus counts persist across base game spins, accumulating toward Wild Reels Feature triggers and Bonus Game thresholds. Progress is linked to current bet level.

specs.description: Chillilot is a Mexican-themed slot with a unique Wild Reels Feature that activates every 10th spin and a progressive Bonus Game system. Players can choose their free spins volatility and wild reel configuration, while persistent progress bars track advancement toward bonus features across multiple base game spins.
